definitions.explanation: The act of passing along information, instructions, or signals from one person or place to another. More formal than simply 伝える.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}の{伝達|でんたつ}が{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: The transmission of information was delayed.

examples.japanese: {指示|しじ}を{正確|せいかく}に{伝達|でんたつ}してください。
{災害時|さいがいじ}の{情報|じょうほう}{伝達|でんたつ}{手段|しゅだん}を{事前|じぜん}に{確認|かくにん}しておくべきだ。
examples.english: We should confirm the means of communication in advance for times of disaster.

notes:
A formal word used in organizational, military, and scientific contexts. In biology, {神経|しんけい}{伝達|でんたつ} refers to nerve signal transmission. In organizations, it emphasizes the systematic passing of information down a chain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{情報|じょうほう}{伝達|でんたつ} (information transmission)
・{命令|めいれい}{伝達|でんたつ} (transmission of orders)
・{神経|しんけい}{伝達|でんたつ} (nerve transmission)
・{伝達|でんたつ}{事項|じこう} (matters to be communicated)
・{伝達|でんたつ}{手段|しゅだん} (means of communication)
